title: Queue occupancy and server size distribution of a queue length dependent vacation queue with an optional service
summary: The discrete time queueing system is highly applicable to modern telecommunication systems, where it provides adaptive packet handling, congestion controlled security/inspection, energy efficient operation, and supports bursty traffic common in 5G, Internet of Things (IoT), and edge computing environments. In this article, we analyze an infinite-buffer discrete-time batch-arrival queue with single and multiple vacation policy where customers are served in batches, in two phases, namely first essential service (FES) and second optional service (SOS).
